address: 闵行区吴中路1599号上海万象城1楼L112C西北门旁, 上海市（距地铁10号线紫藤路站出入口步行380米）
description_en: Japanese matcha gelato brand (小红书: Azabuya麻布屋 / 麻布屋风物手帖 / 今天麻布了没), run by Shanghai Yongban Catering Management Co. Ltd Minhang Branch (上海永坂餐饮管理有限公司闵行分公司). This location is on the 1st floor of Shanghai IFC Mixc (万象城) in Minhang, unit L112C near the northwest entrance, a 380m walk from an exit of Zitengroad station on metro Line 10. Hours 10:00-22:00. Menu: double scoop 35rmb, triple scoop 38rmb, cone 40rmb, 450ml tub 90rmb, 1kg box 120rmb, 1.5kg box 180rmb. Four flavors carry a premium: Matcha #2 and pistachio (tub 95rmb, 1kg box 150rmb, 1.5kg box 225rmb), Matcha #3 (tub 98rmb, 1kg box 210rmb, 1.5kg box 315rmb), Matcha #5 (tub 115rmb, 1kg box 380rmb, 1.5kg box 480rmb). Of the three matcha concentration levels (#2/#3/#5), #3 is the recommended middle ground — #5 tends to taste bitter. Other flavors: black sesame, hojicha, lychee white tea, Japanese yuzu, pistachio, raspberry, grapefruit sea-salt lychee, shochu chocolate, Greek yogurt. The brand has 5 locations in Shanghai (Wulumuqi Middle Road, Xingye Taikoo Hui, Shanghai IFC Mixc Minhang, Yongkang Road, Yanping Road) plus branches in Hangzhou, Shenzhen, and Suzhou.
description_zh: 日式抹茶冰淇淋品牌（小红书号：Azabuya麻布屋、麻布屋风物手帖、今天麻布了没），由上海永坂餐饮管理有限公司闵行分公司运营。本店位于闵行区上海万象城1楼L112C西北门旁，距地铁10号线紫藤路站出入口步行380米，营业时间10:00-22:00。价格：双拼35rmb，三拼38rmb，蛋筒40rmb，桶装450ml90rmb，盒装1kg120rmb，盒装1.5kg180rmb；四个口味有特殊定价：抹茶#2和开心果（桶装95rmb，盒装1kg150rmb，盒装1.5kg225rmb），抹茶#3（桶装98rmb，盒装1kg210rmb，盒装1.5kg315rmb），抹茶#5（桶装115rmb，盒装1kg380rmb，盒装1.5kg480rmb）。抹茶#2、#3、#5三种浓度里，建议选#3，#5会比较苦。其他口味：黑芝麻、焙茶、荔枝白茶、日本柚子、开心果、树莓、西柚海盐荔枝、烧酒巧克力、希腊酸奶。该品牌在上海共有5家门店（乌鲁木齐中路店、兴业太古汇店、上海万象城店、永康路店、延平路店），另外在杭州、深圳、苏州也有门店。
